lines: *Panting* Haa...! We somehow managed to get into the building!
It's only going to get harder from here! Stay on your toes.
Running as fast as we could from the forest to the back entrance, we had arrived safely at the academy building.
G-, give me a moment to catch my breath!!
What is Hebiko gonna do with you...
(We probably can't avoid fights from now on. Might be a good idea to take a quick break and prepare ourselves.)
I was thinking about Tokiko, whom we had left behind in the forest.
In the forest, the two butlers were facing each other.
Hehehe... Being a butler is a tough job, don't you think?
I never thought of this as a tough job.
Right? The same goes for me.
The two looked as if they were conversing calmly, but in fact the air was rife with nervous energy, just like the surface tension of a cup filled to the brim.
What an irresponsible man you are.
Haha. You know, it's not like sticking women on a skewer is a hobby of mine. Maybe I'll let you go if you get naked and beg for your life?
Gonza was the first to break the tension.
He stuck his spear into the ground and dove beneath the soil, as if he were jumping into a swimming pool.
Hehe... I know you're an expert at using kunai. But it's not like you can attack me if I'm underground!!!!
Tokiko sensed something and jumped to the side.
And only a moment later, a spear thrust out of the ground where she had been standing.
Haa, not getting impaled by the first attack? You're totally different from those rookies.
I see... so this is your true technique.
The Earth Jutsu utilized his spear art, making his attacks powerful and hard to avoid. The grave markers all around belonged to those who had fallen to this technique.
Just look at the results all around you. Not bad, huh?
That being said, it definitely was a powerful technique. Even for Gonza it must have been a tremendous effort to develop his Earth Jutsu.
Hey, hey! Stop daydreaming! Or do you want to be the next to get skewered!?
In a flash, the spear was aiming at Tokiko again and again. The only thing she could do for now was dodge the attacks directed at her.
What's wrong!? The great butler of the head family can't win just by dancing around!!
Tokiko squinted and readied her kunai.
Ha! Do you plan to block my spear with just your kunai!? Who's the stupid one now!!
The kunai Tokiko threw at the last moment seemed to have been easily deflected by Gonza's spear... Howeverー
Surprisingly, his spear changed direction as if dragged by the kunai, and swung through nothing but air.
And almost as though he were being fished out by his flying spear, Gonza appeared from the ground.
Without a moment's delay, Tokiko flung numerous kunai.
Having been thrown into the air, Gonza had no way to escape and was pierced by the kunai all over, knocking him to the ground.
It seemed that the fight had been settled, but Tokiko didn't lower her guard yet.
Gonza, who had supposedly been pierced just moments ago, rose up from underground. At the same time, the Gonza lying on the ground turned to earth and started to break apart.
So the rumor was true, your Evil Eye: Clairvoyant Eye can really see to the "core" of things.
I underestimated you because I thought you were more of a supporter than a frontline fighter, but it was good that I tested your abilities.
You too. It looks like you have honed your Earth Jutsu quite a bit. Marvelous adaptablilty; I underestimated you as well.
It was a skill combining Earth Jutsu and spear art, one that was challenging to control. And it was a Ninja Art that could even create a clone of his body in an instant.
Tokiko was genuinely impressed at how hard he must have trained in secret.
Hey, it sure would be a shame to kill a woman like you. I'll make you mine, so how about you surrender?
That was coooold~! But that just makes me fall harder for you. Guess I'll have to make you fall in love with me by force!!
The two readied their weapons and faced each other again.
Who's there!? We've already sealed off the building!!
It looked like taking a break had been a mistake. The school building had already fallen into the hand of the rebels.
Eeehhh! Enemies already...! Fuma, don't you have some kind of plan again!?
Hm? Did you just call him "Fuma"...?
I recognized the man who was blocking our way. He was a genin, a lower ninja taking direct orders from Gaiza, meaning he was a Taimanin of the Fuma Clan.
The man's words became choppy upon seeing my face.
I assumed a dignified air as best I could and turned to speak to the ninja unhurriedly.
Where is Gaiza? I have something to discuss with him as the head of the Fuma's head family.
I-I was ordered not to let anyone pass!
Are you going against a direct order from the Fuma clan head? That makes it treason against your direct masters, the Nisha family, as well.
Are you content with such an outcome?
(Good, he needs just one more push.)
The man who had appeared was a Fire Art user, known for his wild temperament even among Gaiza's followers.
My ruse had been going well and it looked like we'd be able to break through, and then this guy appeared. For now, I continued with the plan since it wouldn't hurt to try.
I want to speak with Gaiza. Let us pass.
It's Gaiza-"sama", you little shit. Do you think you're still the clan head? Starting from today, the head of the Fuma Clan is Gaiza-sama. Kill them!
But there was nothing we could do about it.
He's not a good listener, huh. Hebiko! Shikanosuke!
My "electric waves" are ready to go!
